title: Story work item
description: The behavior altitude (portfolio ADR-0015): a goal stated as behavior specifications (BDD scenarios). The BODY is the contract — the scenarios live there and are what the approval hash pins; frontmatter is state. Sign-off (draft -> ready) is a human seat confirming the behavior and requires the parent project to be signed off first; close (-> done) requires every child task terminal.

id.description: Stable opaque page identifier (ULID, tool-generated). Links target this, not the path.

status.description: Work-item lifecycle, aligned to conduit workitem::Status (transitions enforced by conduit's doors)

created.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the story was created

project.description: Id (preferred) or slug of the parent project — sign-off flows downhill through this edge, done flows uphill

by.description: The human seat that signed off the behavior

content_sha256.description: sha256 of the page body exactly as signed — any body edit breaks it and bounces the item to draft. Written only by conduit's sign-off door, never by the harness (suite convention, portfolio ADR-0015).

approval.description: Sign-off seal. Its presence is what makes an item executable; only the owning door writes it.

x-wiki-types.story: Work-item story: a behavior-altitude goal (BDD scenarios)
